note: Our own fixtures for Skye's prompt review (features/script-editor.clan). Each case runs every intent.

lines.text: It starts to rain on a grey street. @maya_front opens a bright yellow @umbrella_open and grins up at the sky.
Slow push in; the yellow is the only colour.
@maya_front lifts the lid off a steaming pot in a sunny kitchen, tastes the soup from a wooden spoon and nods slowly.
Warm morning light from the left.
@maya_front walks the length of the waterline at dawn as the light comes up gold behind her, then stops and looks out to sea.
Unhurried; hold on her face.
A @jogger runs past far behind @maya_front as she ties her laces on a park bench.
Shallow focus on Maya.
A cold @soda_can sweats on a picnic table. A hand reaches in, cracks it open, and the fizz rises.
Macro; slow motion on the fizz.
@sai_front pedals across a busy bridge at rush hour, weaving past stopped cars, smiling under his helmet.
Tracking alongside at handlebar height.
@maya_front answers her phone on a crowded train, covers her other ear, and laughs at whatever she hears.
Handheld, close.
In a small coffee shop, the barista slides a cup across the counter to @sai_front, who takes the first sip and closes his eyes.
Steam catches the window light.
A muddy @dog_rex bounds through the park and leaps into @maya_front's arms, knocking her hat off.
Wide, then a whip pan to the catch.
@sai_front opens a thin @laptop_silver on a kitchen table, and the screen lights his face blue in the dark room.
Only the screen lights the scene.
Rain drums on a greenhouse roof while @maya_front repots a small tomato plant, humming to herself.
Rain sound up; soft focus outside.
At a busy street market, @sai_front holds up a ripe mango, sniffs it, and hands coins to the stallholder.
Colourful, crowded background.
@maya_front reaches the mountain summit, drops her backpack, and spreads her arms in the wind above the clouds.
Drone pull-out to reveal the peaks.
@sai_front runs for the last night bus, the doors close, then open again; the driver waves him on.
Wide from across the street.
Flour rises in a beam of light as @maya_front pulls a golden loaf from the oven and taps its base.
Close on the tap; hear the hollow sound.
@sai_front rolls a stripe of bright blue paint across a white wall, steps back, and tilts his head.
Locked off; he walks out of frame.
@maya_front dives off a wooden jetty into a still lake, and the ripples spread to the far shore.
Hold on the ripples after she is gone.
On a noisy platform @sai_front slips on @headphones_black, and the crowd noise drops away to music.
Sound cuts to the music on the put-on.
@maya_front sits in her first car, grips the wheel with both hands, takes a breath, and turns the key.
Interior, low angle up at her.
The logo settles over a slow pan across a calm sea at dusk.
Leave space for the tagline.

Quick cuts, each task one strike.

proceed.why: The owner's case (2026-10-15): an empty script's one line, sent from its prompt start as a draft. skye.v2 asked 'Draft the scene as written?' with one option, 'Draft it', and the question was shown nowhere. A draft must come back; a question only with a real choice or a missing fact.

length.why: Live test 2026-11-18: a 15 s film drafted from one line came back at about 60 s on the band (7 action lines of 3-4 beats each). The draft must fit target_s by rule 10 (rough_seconds).

lines.text: A tired dad makes Hearth Oats for his sleepy daughter on a frosty farm morning; tender and a little funny; the red pack on show; ends on 'Hearth Oats. Slow down, warm up.'

length.title: Script

length.why: Live test 2026-11-18: 'Make it 15 s' on the 7-beat scene trimmed adjectives and kept every beat (about 53 s on the band). fit_seconds on a scene must cut beats until rule 10 says 15 s.

lines.text: Pale blue light. Frost on the window. A tired DAD in a rumpled jumper stands at the stove, shoulders up against the cold, breath faintly visible.
He tears open a red Hearth Oats pack and tips oats into a small pot. The pack stays in frame on the counter.
His sleepy DAUGHTER shuffles in wearing a coat over her pyjamas and one wellington boot. She climbs onto a chair and rests her head on the table.
Dad stirs. Steam rises and softens the window. His shoulders drop. He stirs slower, then slower still.
He sets a warm bowl before her. She wraps both hands around it and sighs. He yawns. She yawns back.
He sits beside her, still in his coat, and eats from her bowl. She lets him.
The red pack glows on the counter in the first gold sun.
NARRATOR (V.O.)
Hearth Oats. Slow down, warm up.

length.why: UAT round 3 (R3-F7): 'Make it 10 seconds' just after the person asked for her whispered 'Good boy.' cut that line. A shorter version keeps every spoken line word for word and finds the time in the action (skye.v7 rule 11).

lines.text: 1 a.m. A dark kitchen, lit only by the open fridge.
A flatmate in socks and dressing gown creeps in, bracing for noise.
She sets the Quietboil on its base and flips the switch, wincing.
The kettle glows blue and boils without a sound.
WOMAN
whispering, to the kettle
Good boy.
Through the thin wall, a flatmate's snoring carries on, undisturbed.
She pours her tea and raises the mug to the wall in a silent toast.
NARRATOR (V.O.)
Quietboil. Let them sleep.
